interaction: Hold the staged FUEL clear of the spinning flywheel through the loaded transit

summary.condition: start from the entry-nominal stage; feeder roller stopped and braked; floor belt surface 1.2 m/s toward the flywheel; robot acceleration 1.5 g forward; 30 N from queued FUEL behind; flywheel surface held at 13.6 m/s

metric.name: least clearance to the spinning flywheel (mm)
metric.requirement: stays at least 10 mm clear of the flywheel for 2 s with the feeder stopped

control.firstUnmet: the FUEL reaches the spinning flywheel with no feed commanded

brackets.failingFirstUnmet: the FUEL reaches the spinning flywheel with no feed commanded
